company.shortDescription: Proof Trading is an institutional equities broker that aims to get investors better prices.
company.description:
Proof Trading is an institutional equities broker that aims to get investors better prices. Finance is a bloated industry. It is opaque and old-fashioned, and it has not substantially improved through the technological revolution in the way other industries have, in part because there are tremendous barriers to entry for new innovative players.

Proof Trading was founded in 2019 and is based in New York, New York.

insights.statement: The latest disclosed Seed round raised $4,649,990, or 100% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $5,958,818 to $20,408,222, a 3.42x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
